text: {"lessons":["A single sale after a steep decline can lock in a painful loss; I should decide using the holding’s outlook and portfolio risk, not just the urge to stop the pain.","My account’s rebound after another down period shows why I should avoid treating short-term moves as proof that a trade was right or wrong.","Before each period, I should set clear review and rebalancing rules so that infrequent check-ins do not turn into either neglect or impulsive trading."]}
